translationhub — bundled landscape artwork

blue-hour.svg           青の時間 / Blue hour
mountain-morning.svg    山の朝 / Mountain morning
forest-stillness.svg    森の静けさ / Forest stillness

These are original procedural vector illustrations created for translationhub.
They are not photographs, and do not reproduce or contain third-party images.
The deterministic authoring source is included as generate-scenes.mjs.

The artwork and its generation source are dedicated to the public domain under
CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0-1.0). To the extent legally possible, all copyright and
related rights are waived. They may be copied, modified, and redistributed,
including as part of commercial software, without asking permission.

CC0 legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode
No attribution is required. Suggested optional credit:
"Original landscape illustrations for translationhub, CC0 1.0."

The site antwi.dev was considered as visual inspiration only. Its images,
photographs, source code, and other assets are not included in these files.

User-supplied photos are not bundled or covered by this dedication. They stay
within the user's browser storage. Any rights to those photos remain with their
respective rights holders.

App icons: icon-192.png and icon-512.png are raster versions of the project's
original mark.svg. They follow the same license as mark.svg and the application,
not the separate CC0 dedication for the three landscape illustrations above.

The atmosphere/ directory contains original AI-assisted illustrations for
花霞 (cherry blossoms), 燕の空 (swallows), and 陽だまり (sunlit flowers),
their theme previews and a procedurally generated paper grain tile.
These bundled images are also dedicated under CC0 1.0 Universal as described
above. Theme compositions are defined in atmosphere.js and atmosphere.css.
